stem: Find the general term of the sequence $\{a_n\}$: ${=T[0]}, {=T[1]}, {=T[2]}, {=T[3]}, {=T[4]}, \dots$ Write your answer as $a_n = \dots$
solution: It is geometric with first term ${=m*(r-1)}$ and common ratio ${=r}$, so $b_n = {=m*(r-1)}\times {=r}^{n-1}$.
Check $n = 1$: ${=m}\times 1 + {=q} = {=T[0]} = a_1$, so the formula holds for $n = 1$.
notes: Advanced: geometric difference sequence whose first term is not equal to its ratio, with the geometric sum formula; a_n = m r^(n-1) + q. Formula holds at n=1. Sums have exactly n-1 terms.
